Never combine separate numbered or lettered sibling limbs in one proposal. Coordinated verbs within one limb stay together when they express one action. Separate list limbs with distinct legal effects must use distinct group_ref values even when their family_key and subtype_key are identical. Group proposals only when they express the same proposition. Repeat a parent or chapeau qualification in each affected proposal when needed. Populate required roles with source-authored content. Optional roles, including timing, qualification and forum, are omitted when the source has no such words; never fill a role with a connective such as "Accordingly", a section reference alone, a court named elsewhere, or the words "none", "none stated" or "not applicable". An absent role is absent. Do not replace source-authored detail with phrases such as "subject to stated exceptions" or "other customary limitations". Do not move an exclusion or qualification that applies only to one limb or category into a global qualification. Every selected evidence quote set must support every material part of the proposal statement and roles. Use multiple exact quotes when the support is non-contiguous. Every evidence quote must be a contiguous verbatim substring of its declared closure component. Do not add quotation marks, ellipses, omissions or normalisation. Split long support into multiple exact quotes. Copy the exact required and optional role keys from the applicable family contract. Copy only source_span_id values supplied in the source closure. Do not generate or alter source span IDs. Each proposal must include at least one evidence quote owned by the analysed section. Definition and cross-reference text from another structure node may qualify or explain an owned fact, but cannot independently create a proposal. Use links only when both endpoints are proposals in this response. For a source-proved relationship from a local proposal to an existing fact in another structure node, use cross_section_links. Name the local from_ref. Identify the target by its supplied structure_node_id, family, subtype, fact type and exact target evidence. Use only names supplied in cross_section_target_contracts. Cite separate exact source text from the analysed section that states the relationship. Do not emit a cross-section relationship from a section reference alone or guess a target or relationship type. Create semantic definition, qualification, requirement or exception links only when the source supports that relationship. When one exception, condition or definition affects multiple emitted proposals, link it to every affected proposal for which the relationship type is allowed. Keep conditions, exceptions, thresholds and timing as roles or linked facts. Before setting coverage, make a second source-ordered pass through the entire authored unit. Confirm that every sentence and list limb with legal effect is represented, including affirmative chapeaux, provisos, exceptions, limitations, carve-outs, savings clauses, no-duty or no-remedy statements, incorporation clauses, and numeric, geographic or business-scope limits. Do not stop after the primary covenant. For numeric fact values, return the contract canonical scalar only; keep units and source wording in roles and evidence.
